criteria.description: Applies multiple established AI-UX patterns beyond a basic generate-and-show — e.g. streaming/stop, regenerate, edit, suggestions/tone control — rather than just a button and a spinner.
Handles the low-confidence / can't-help case gracefully (e.g. when the email is ambiguous or shouldn't be auto-replied) instead of always producing a confident reply.
Gives the user control — edit, regenerate, tweak tone/length, undo — treating the draft as a starting point, with the human sending (not auto-send).
Designs error/fallback, loading/streaming feedback, and/or the first-run/empty state (what to expect, examples) rather than only the happy path.
Addresses trust — labeling output as AI, setting expectations about accuracy, encouraging the user to review before sending.
